links.outcome: Prognosis and advance care planning documentation after ML-based patient selection with care coaches, in a stepped-wedge trial
links.effect: Prognosis documentation within 14 days 2.9% vs 1.1% (aOR 4.3, P<.001); ACP documentation 7.7% vs 1.8% (aOR 14.2, P<.001).
links.quote: The proportion of visits with prognosis documentation within 14 days was higher in the intervention condition than in the control condition: 2.9% vs 1.1% (adjusted odds ratio = 4.3, P < .001).

unlisted_practices: Using predictive survival model to trigger clinician emails and care coach outreach for serious illness conversations

screen.reason: This is a stepped-wedge randomized controlled trial evaluating a real-world clinical deployment of an AI survival model combined with care coaches and clinician nudges to improve advance care planning.

primary.practice: AI-triggered clinician nudges paired with trained care coaches
